item: Row J (6)(b): one feed row for a feed-less entry's tags in both seeds
summary: seed_sources.outlet_feed_row picks the outlet's lowest-id feed row whose baseline already records merged tags, else the lowest-id one with a baseline, else the lowest-id feed row for every feed-less merge, in the main seed and the legal-only seed alike; the main seed used the catalogue's first feed entry, so a reordered catalogue or ids out of catalogue order put one entry's tags on two rows. A feed-less merge whose planned feed was held back on a domain-keyed store now lands on an existing feed row of the outlet when there is one. (6)(a) pinned with tests (legal-only merge, domain without a name).
